title: sphenostylis marginata subsp. obtusifolia
intro: Sphenostylis marginata subsp. obtusifolia, commonly known as the yellow-leafed sphenostylis, is a plant species belonging to the family Leguminosae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antipyretic effects. The therapeutic actions of Sphenostylis marginata subsp. obtusifolia include analgesic, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
